View label

Same mathematical meanings: no

Left image: The filled dot admits −3 for its own bound, but the other constraint rejects that value. Right image: The displayed set includes −3 at its lower bound.

On the left, although the selected dot is filled, the other marked ray does not reach −3. The value is outside the intersection. On the right, the filled endpoint marks an inclusive boundary of the marked ray.

A solver must reject −3 when both marked constraints are required on the left and can accept −3 as a member of the displayed set on the right.
